id.description: Unique request id; usually matches the request filename stem.

protocol_version.description: Absent means legacy v1; new multi-worker requests use 2.

worker.description: Target worker. Muse v2 consumes only worker=muse after poller migration.

task_type.description: High-level work type used for routing and QC.

approval_policy.description: Promotion policy; done never implies approval.

reference_mode.description: Whether Muse receives an accepted external identity or creates a candidate identity first.

character.description: Character or asset key, e.g. general_forgot or enemy_clockwork_knight.

action.description: Action key in snake_case, e.g. attack or jump_overhead_slash.

frames_vi.description: Ordered choreography beats; normally one intended pose/beat per requested frame.

frames.description: Requested frame count for animated assets.

fps.description: Intended playback rate for animation and preview GIF; runtime timing remains authoritative in the game manifest.

grid.description: Legacy/runtime grid hint. V2 creative layout belongs in generation_layout.

cell_size.description: Legacy delivery cell size; v2 prefers runtime_cell_size.

generation_layout.description: Compact high-resolution contact-sheet layout used during generation; not the runtime atlas layout.

runtime_cell_size.description: Final game delivery cell size after high-resolution master processing/downsample.

identity_overrides.description: Explicit temporary identity changes; absence means preserve canonical identity.

status.description: Requester sets pending; worker changes only this field to done/failed when the work bundle is complete/failed.
